name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.1: retrieve.py lazy-forks install.sh when bootstrap.sh didn't run (after /plugin install or /plugin update without restart). v0.2.0: Custom skill registration via /superskillret:add (+ list, remove). v0.1.1: per-session dedup + auto-bootstrap.
